name: Sold Out ~Seido-tachi no Senjou Hinpyoukai~
original_name: SOLD OUT～性奴達の船上品評会～
source:
Marco is a sailor of a trade ship. The ship is registered as a fruit trade vessel, but in fact it deals with  a ship illegal slave trade. Marco is making his debut as a trainer of slaves.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
